sampling: Fixed eight-day spacing selected before forecast scoring to bound this experiment; this samples 48-hour forecasts, not every hour or every possible issuance in the nine-month test interval.
forecast_point: GHCNh station coordinates and elevation, fixed across all source years. These are slightly different from the original ISD pilot points; the old and new numerical scores must not be treated as a controlled same-data comparison.
model_changes: None: retain all seven candidates, ridge features/alpha, static station bias, TimesFM checkpoint/options and finite ECMWF covariate construction from the previous correction pilot. Only the observation source, temporal coverage and sampling protocol change.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks of scheduled origin dates; all stations resampled together; four eight-day slots per block

scoring.season_assignment: Forecast-origin calendar month. These are calendar groupings, not a claim that Indian regional weather regimes have identical season boundaries.

limits: Three fixed airports and sampled origins, not an India-wide, full-grid or complete operational benchmark; no direct Indus predictions are available.
The new GHCNh provider harmonizes SYNOP and METAR temperature and has different metadata/QC from the old ISD pilot. All current methods share this source; old May scores are not directly comparable.
Source 223 quality 1 means good. For new NOAA sources 412/413, an empty quality flag is accepted but is not proof that all QC passed. Source IDs, report types and flags remain auditable.

Older IFS data are Cycle 49R1 hindcasts. Runs from May 12, 2026 06 UTC use Cycle 50R1. Forecast publication and observation receipt times remain unverified; the six-hour run age and inputs through origin are assumptions.
GHCNh is a retrospective harmonized/QC product, not a snapshot of exactly the observations available at historical issuance time.
Checkpoint pretraining exclusion is unverified. The fresh holdout is unseen by this project's model selection, not proven absent from foundation-model training.
All model choices and the protocol were informed by previous development work, but April-August 2025 evaluation targets are excluded and no settings are tuned on May.
No refitting or station/lead/model switching after development selection. Every rejected or failed scheduled case is counted.
A pass supports only the declared retrospective sampled station comparison, not operational, India-wide, or Pravah superiority.
